package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ContentAccessRepoPG resolves effective public access through the authored
// Course hierarchy and semantic relations.
type ContentAccessRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

const visibleCourseLessonSQL = `
SELECT 1
FROM course c
JOIN course_module cm ON cm.course_id=c.id AND cm.status=1
JOIN module m ON m.id=cm.module_id AND m.status=1
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id=m.id AND ms.status=1
JOIN section s ON s.id=ms.section_id AND s.status=1
JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id=s.id AND sl.status=1
JOIN lesson l ON l.id=sl.lesson_id AND l.status=1
WHERE c.status=2 AND c.catalog_visible=true`

const activeCourseLessonSQL = `
SELECT 1
FROM course c
JOIN course_module cm ON cm.course_id=c.id AND cm.status=1
JOIN module m ON m.id=cm.module_id AND m.status=1
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id=m.id AND ms.status=1
JOIN section s ON s.id=ms.section_id AND s.status=1
JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id=s.id AND sl.status=1
JOIN lesson l ON l.id=sl.lesson_id AND l.status=1
WHERE c.status=2`

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM course WHERE id=$1 AND status=2 AND catalog_visible=true)`, courseID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewModule(ctx context.Context, moduleID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(
SELECT 1 FROM module m
WHERE m.id=$1 AND m.status=1 AND (
    m.visibility IN (2,3) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM course_module cm
        JOIN course c ON c.id=cm.course_id
        WHERE cm.module_id=m.id AND cm.status=1 AND c.status=2 AND c.catalog_visible=true
    )
))`, moduleID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewSection(ctx context.Context, sectionID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(
SELECT 1
FROM section s
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id=s.id AND ms.status=1
JOIN module m ON m.id=ms.module_id AND m.status=1
WHERE s.id=$1 AND s.status=1 AND (
    m.visibility IN (2,3) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM course_module cm
        JOIN course c ON c.id=cm.course_id
        WHERE cm.module_id=m.id AND cm.status=1 AND c.status=2 AND c.catalog_visible=true
    )
))`, sectionID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS((`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=$1) UNION ALL (
SELECT 1
FROM module m
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id=m.id AND ms.status=1
JOIN section s ON s.id=ms.section_id AND s.status=1
JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id=s.id AND sl.status=1
JOIN lesson l ON l.id=sl.lesson_id AND l.status=1
WHERE m.status=1 AND m.visibility IN (2,3) AND l.id=$1
))`, lessonID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(
SELECT 1 FROM task t
WHERE t.id=$1 AND t.status=1 AND EXISTS((`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=t.lesson_id) UNION ALL (
    SELECT 1
    FROM module m
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id=m.id AND ms.status=1
    JOIN section s ON s.id=ms.section_id AND s.status=1
    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id=s.id AND sl.status=1
    JOIN lesson l ON l.id=sl.lesson_id AND l.status=1
    WHERE m.status=1 AND m.visibility IN (2,3) AND l.id=t.lesson_id
)))`, taskID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewExample(ctx context.Context, exampleID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(
SELECT 1 FROM lesson_example e
WHERE e.id=$1 AND e.status=1 AND EXISTS((`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=e.lesson_id) UNION ALL (
    SELECT 1
    FROM module m
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id=m.id AND ms.status=1
    JOIN section s ON s.id=ms.section_id AND s.status=1
    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id=s.id AND sl.status=1
    JOIN lesson l ON l.id=sl.lesson_id AND l.status=1
    WHERE m.status=1 AND m.visibility IN (2,3) AND l.id=e.lesson_id
)))`, exampleID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewLessonViaRelation(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, relationID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(
SELECT 1 FROM lesson_relation lr
WHERE lr.id=$2 AND lr.target_lesson_id=$1
  AND EXISTS(`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=lr.source_lesson_id)
  AND EXISTS(`+activeCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=lr.target_lesson_id)
)`, lessonID, relationID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewTaskViaRelation(ctx context.Context, taskID string, relationID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS(
SELECT 1
FROM task t
JOIN lesson_relation lr ON lr.target_lesson_id=t.lesson_id
WHERE t.id=$1 AND t.status=1 AND lr.id=$2
  AND EXISTS(`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=lr.source_lesson_id)
  AND EXISTS(`+activeCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=lr.target_lesson_id)
)`, taskID, relationID)
}

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) CanViewExampleViaRelation(ctx context.Context, exampleID string, relationID string) (bool, error) {
	return r.exists(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS((
SELECT 1
FROM lesson_example e
JOIN lesson_relation lr ON lr.target_lesson_id=e.lesson_id
WHERE e.id=$1 AND e.status=1 AND lr.id=$2
  AND EXISTS(`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=lr.source_lesson_id)
  AND EXISTS(`+activeCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=lr.target_lesson_id)
) UNION ALL (
SELECT 1
FROM lesson_example_relation er
JOIN lesson_example source_example ON source_example.id=er.source_example_id AND source_example.status=1
JOIN lesson_example target_example ON target_example.id=er.target_example_id AND target_example.status=1
WHERE target_example.id=$1 AND er.id=$2
  AND EXISTS(`+visibleCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=source_example.lesson_id)
  AND EXISTS(`+activeCourseLessonSQL+` AND l.id=target_example.lesson_id)
))`, exampleID, relationID)
}

// ResolveLessonReadAccess returns the most permissive effective policy among
// the active placements through which each reusable lesson can be reached.
// Within each placement, the nearest explicit hierarchy value wins.
func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) ResolveLessonReadAccess(ctx context.Context, lessonIDs []string, includeHiddenCourses bool) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error) {
	result := make(map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, len(lessonIDs))
	if len(lessonIDs) == 0 {
		return result, nil
	}

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, lessonReadAccessSQL, lessonIDs, includeHiddenCourses)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	for rows.Next() {
		var lessonID string
		var resolution domain.LessonReadAccessResolution
		if err := rows.Scan(&lessonID, &resolution.Effective, &resolution.SourceType, &resolution.SourceID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result[lessonID] = resolution
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

// ResolveCourseLessonReadAccess returns the most permissive policy among the
// active catalog placements of one requested visible course.
func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) ResolveCourseLessonReadAccess(ctx context.Context, courseID string, lessonIDs []string) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error) {
	result := make(map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, len(lessonIDs))
	if len(lessonIDs) == 0 {
		return result, nil
	}

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, courseLessonReadAccessSQL, lessonIDs, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	for rows.Next() {
		var lessonID string
		var resolution domain.LessonReadAccessResolution
		if err := rows.Scan(&lessonID, &resolution.Effective, &resolution.SourceType, &resolution.SourceID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result[lessonID] = resolution
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

const courseLessonReadAccessSQL = `
WITH placements AS (
    SELECT
        l.id AS lesson_id,
        COALESCE(
            l.lesson_read_access,
            s.lesson_read_access,
            m.lesson_read_access,
            c.lesson_read_access,
            cg.lesson_read_access,
            cl.lesson_read_access,
            tr.lesson_read_access,
            'student'
        ) AS effective_access,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'lesson'
            WHEN s.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'section'
            WHEN m.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'module'
            WHEN c.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'course'
            WHEN cg.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'course_group'
            WHEN cl.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'level'
            WHEN tr.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'track'
            ELSE 'default'
        END AS source_type,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN l.id::text
            WHEN s.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN s.id::text
            WHEN m.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN m.id::text
            WHEN c.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN c.id::text
            WHEN cg.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN cg.id::text
            WHEN cl.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN cl.id::text
            WHEN tr.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN tr.id::text
            ELSE ''
        END AS source_id
    FROM lesson l
    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.lesson_id=l.id AND sl.status=1
    JOIN section s ON s.id=sl.section_id AND s.status=1
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id=s.id AND ms.status=1
    JOIN module m ON m.id=ms.module_id AND m.status=1
    JOIN course_module cm ON cm.module_id=m.id AND cm.status=1
    JOIN course c ON c.id=cm.course_id AND c.status=2 AND c.catalog_visible=TRUE
    LEFT JOIN course_group_course cgc ON cgc.course_id=c.id AND cgc.status=1
    LEFT JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id=cgc.group_id AND cg.status=1
    LEFT JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id=cg.id AND lcg.status=1
    LEFT JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id=lcg.level_id AND cl.status=1
    LEFT JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id=cl.id AND tl.status=1
    LEFT JOIN track tr ON tr.id=tl.track_id AND tr.status=1
    WHERE l.id=ANY($1::uuid[])
      AND l.status=1
      AND c.id=$2
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lesson_id,
        effective_access,
        source_type,
        source_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lesson_id
            ORDER BY CASE effective_access
                WHEN 'guest' THEN 0
                WHEN 'student' THEN 1
                WHEN 'student_pro' THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END,
            source_type,
            source_id
        ) AS rank
    FROM placements
)
SELECT lesson_id, effective_access, source_type, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rank=1
`

const lessonReadAccessSQL = `
WITH placements AS (
    SELECT
        l.id AS lesson_id,
        COALESCE(
            l.lesson_read_access,
            s.lesson_read_access,
            m.lesson_read_access,
            c.lesson_read_access,
            cg.lesson_read_access,
            cl.lesson_read_access,
            tr.lesson_read_access,
            'student'
        ) AS effective_access,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'lesson'
            WHEN s.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'section'
            WHEN m.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'module'
            WHEN c.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'course'
            WHEN cg.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'course_group'
            WHEN cl.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'level'
            WHEN tr.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'track'
            ELSE 'default'
        END AS source_type,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN l.id::text
            WHEN s.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN s.id::text
            WHEN m.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN m.id::text
            WHEN c.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN c.id::text
            WHEN cg.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN cg.id::text
            WHEN cl.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN cl.id::text
            WHEN tr.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN tr.id::text
            ELSE ''
        END AS source_id
    FROM lesson l
    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.lesson_id=l.id AND sl.status=1
    JOIN section s ON s.id=sl.section_id AND s.status=1
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id=s.id AND ms.status=1
    JOIN module m ON m.id=ms.module_id AND m.status=1
    JOIN course_module cm ON cm.module_id=m.id AND cm.status=1
    JOIN course c ON c.id=cm.course_id AND c.status=2
    LEFT JOIN course_group_course cgc ON cgc.course_id=c.id AND cgc.status=1
    LEFT JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id=cgc.group_id AND cg.status=1
    LEFT JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id=cg.id AND lcg.status=1
    LEFT JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id=lcg.level_id AND cl.status=1
    LEFT JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id=cl.id AND tl.status=1
    LEFT JOIN track tr ON tr.id=tl.track_id AND tr.status=1
    WHERE l.id=ANY($1::uuid[])
      AND l.status=1
      AND ($2 OR c.catalog_visible=TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        l.id AS lesson_id,
        COALESCE(l.lesson_read_access, s.lesson_read_access, m.lesson_read_access, 'student') AS effective_access,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'lesson'
            WHEN s.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'section'
            WHEN m.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN 'module'
            ELSE 'default'
        END AS source_type,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN l.id::text
            WHEN s.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN s.id::text
            WHEN m.lesson_read_access IS NOT NULL THEN m.id::text
            ELSE ''
        END AS source_id
    FROM lesson l
    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.lesson_id=l.id AND sl.status=1
    JOIN section s ON s.id=sl.section_id AND s.status=1
    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.section_id=s.id AND ms.status=1
    JOIN module m ON m.id=ms.module_id AND m.status=1 AND m.visibility IN (2,3)
    WHERE l.id=ANY($1::uuid[])
      AND l.status=1
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lesson_id,
        effective_access,
        source_type,
        source_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lesson_id
            ORDER BY CASE effective_access
                WHEN 'guest' THEN 0
                WHEN 'student' THEN 1
                WHEN 'student_pro' THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END,
            source_type,
            source_id
        ) AS rank
    FROM placements
)
SELECT lesson_id, effective_access, source_type, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rank=1
`

func (r ContentAccessRepoPG) exists(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (bool, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	var allowed bool
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, query, args...).Scan(&allowed); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return allowed, nil
}

var _ repository.ContentAccessRepository = (*ContentAccessRepoPG)(nil)
var _ repository.LessonReadAccessRepository = (*ContentAccessRepoPG)(nil)
var _ repository.CourseLessonReadAccessRepository = (*ContentAccessRepoPG)(nil)
